value.signature: fn body_projection (body : & ProposalBody) -> Result < Value , ProfileError >

review.body: { let Value :: Array (original) = super :: body_projection (& body . structural) ? else { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } ; let mut fields = original . as_slice () . to_vec () ; fields . insert (1 , Value :: Bytes (Bytes :: from (body . retirement_point . to_vec ()))) ; let result = array (fields) ; if result . canonical_len () > 1_048_576 { return Err (ProfileError :: Bound) ; } Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
